If you have received a damaged item, I am sorry for the disappointment. It is handled through our standard returns process, with a couple of small pointers so we can put it right quickly.
What to do:
Register your return using our online returns portal (opens in a new tab) and select “Damaged” as the reason.
Use the returns label generated; UK returns are free.
Timeframes are the same as our normal policy:
Full‑price items: return within 30 days of receipt.
Sale items: register the return within 14 days, then return within a further 14 days.
